description: Defines structures, enums, and classes used throughout the libANGLE library, including geometric types, rendering states, sampler states, and utility functions.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Represents a rectangular area with position and size, with methods for geometric operations.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: Represents a 3D offset with x, y, z components.

classes.name: Extents
classes.description: Represents dimensions in 3D space, with width, height, and depth.

classes.name: Box
classes.description: Defines a 3D box with position and size, convertible to a rectangle.

classes.name: RasterizerState
classes.description: Encapsulates rasterization rendering state parameters.

classes.name: BlendState
classes.description: Encapsulates blending state parameters for rendering.

classes.name: DepthStencilState
classes.description: Encapsulates depth and stencil testing state parameters.

classes.name: SamplerState
classes.description: Represents sampler configuration including filtering, wrapping, and border color.

classes.name: DrawArraysIndirectCommand
classes.description: Structure for indirect draw command with array parameters.

classes.name: DrawElementsIndirectCommand
classes.description: Structure for indirect draw command with element parameters.

classes.name: ImageUnit
classes.description: Represents an image unit with associated texture and layout.

classes.name: PixelStoreStateBase
classes.description: Base class for pixel storage state parameters.

classes.name: PixelUnpackState
classes.description: Pixel unpack state extending PixelStoreStateBase.

classes.name: PixelPackState
classes.description: Pixel pack state extending PixelStoreStateBase with additional reverseRowOrder flag.

classes.name: ComponentType
classes.description: Enumeration of component data types used in graphics.

classes.name: angle::FramebufferBinding
classes.description: Enumeration for framebuffer binding points.

classes.name: TextureTypeMap
classes.description: Template alias for mapping TextureType to a generic type.

classes.name: ShaderVector
classes.description: Template for a vector of shader-related data, one per shader.

classes.name: DestroyThenDelete
classes.description: Utility class for destroying and deleting objects with a context.

classes.name: UniqueObjectPointer
classes.description: Smart pointer for managing object lifetime with custom deleter.
